name: vault.cluster.resolve_proposal
description: Approves, amends then approves, or rejects a parked merge or split under the caller's own authority, comparing its revision and recording the ruling atomically.
call: { let owner = if input.grant_ref.is_none() { Some(memory.embedded_owner("vault.cluster.resolve_proposal")?) } else { None }; memory.cluster_resolve_proposal(owner.as_ref(), &input)? }
